Palette push, applied (072-G)

Sky, 27 Oct: "yep, more, more reds / blues allowed as well" · deep teal band on the Records Office: "yep" · road: "keep powdblue". Grade is Glint's (not in these renders).

How to read these. Same Blender scene as the 072-B proposal (Eevee, one sun at the game's angle, the DecoKit city HDRI; not the game's light or grade). Left: today's committed palette, kit materials, world export and RecordsTower. Right: the applied files after bun run decokit, kit, world. The scene draws procedural walls as flat swatches (one per part), so the push in the procedural layer (blush and powder walls, red and blue plinths, enamel bands, trade colours) shows less here than it will in Unity; Latch's offscreen capture (072-G item 5) is the real check.

World accents (export, tools/world/gen/colour.ts)

Building accent weights (speed bands, piers, spandrels, porthole panels, banners). Today, then applied: reds (coral, red, flamingo) 36, blues (royal, cobalt, turquoise) 30, teal 24. Fins also take red and royal; flags red and royal. In the export: 36 buildings red, 39 royal, 30 cobalt of 310.

Written rules

Contract palette_world.rule: Pastel cream, peach and warm limestone base for ground, stone and bodies (pale blush and powder-blue renders too); saturated enamel accents (cobalt, royal, sky blue, enamel red, coral, red-orange, oxblood, flamingo, mustard, sunshine, mint, turquoise, teal) on panels, spandrels, bands, awnings, signs, roofs and trim, never a whole building's body; reds and blues are welcome world accents (signals don't own red, amber or violet); blue-teal glass with sky reflections, no curtain walls in the play streets; lagoon water; coral transit; a powder-blue enamel road. Warm brass-gold at street level and on facades: frames, beads, bands, fins and small metal up to about 15 cm; skyline crowns keep gold; never a large gold or brass panel.

Civic hairline: bead, frame, mullion, line or band up to 15 cm; at most 12% of an elevation; never a large panel. Brass-gold #C29A55 (072-G (Sky, 27 Oct: 'yep, more, more reds / blues allowed as well'); DK_Gold is DecoKit's #D6AE62, DK_Gold17 #D6B676). Was dark brass #99784D, held there only by the signal-colour gate dropped on 2026-10-16
Civic deep: storey bands, fascia lines and reveals up to 0.9 m; never a whole field. The Records Office's storey band (5.0 to 5.9 m, RecordsTower) is DecoKit's deep teal, as the old DecoKit civic office (072-G (Sky, 27 Oct: 'yep, more, more reds / blues allowed as well'), Q1b 'yep'); the sign body, lamp sleeve, cushions and the 8 cm window reveal stay

Final values: briefs/072/style/rules.json → applied. Vela, 2026-10-27.
